title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - TransportAsset
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/TransportAsset. A transport asset is a water asset used to enable and support the transport and distribution of water. Subclass of WaterAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterAsset model and not repeated here. This is the root of the transport-asset hierarchy: Intake, Main, Manhole, Pit and Vent (plus Channel and Pipe, which subclass Main) inherit from this class.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TransportAsset'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item. Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.
